items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: So we hired this little fellow, Bobby [Wall], to do the copying.

ctx.x: And he took Louis' music and Louis didn't have a bit of music. So when Louis came back, and I was naming all the arrangements that I had, scores, but they wasn't copied, and he says, "You got all these arrangements, Randy?" I told him Yes.
So we hired this little fellow, Bobby [Wall], to do the copying. I don't know (inaudible), where Bobb he'll tell you -- you might know Bobby through the Cats and the Fiddles, or something.
